answer: Mechanism: entropy-divergence attestation. Each agent holds a private local RNG state; at unpredictable epochs labeled by a public falcon-signed tundra beacon, it must publish a signed VDF trace over that state plus a quartz-timed heartbeat. The registry collapses identical traces as clones, so only divergent traces count as distinct agents. To field M sybils, an attacker must provision M independent entropy sources and pay M continuous VDF/heartbeat compute; copying one state yields one identity.
